metadata.title: Biharmonic submanifolds in nonpositive space forms
metadata.abstract: We prove that there are no proper biharmonic submanifolds with parallel normalized mean curvature vector field in a nonpositive space form, in arbitrary dimension and codimension. We also prove that every biharmonic surface with flat normal bundle in a four-dimensional nonpositive space form is minimal. These results provide substantial support for Chen's conjecture and the generalized Chen's conjecture for hyperbolic space in higher codimensions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究非正曲率空间形式中双调和子流形何时必须极小。
techniques: 平行单位平均曲率方向
analysis.breakthrough: PNMCV 情形沿平均曲率大小的梯度方向写常微分方程，以延拓估计排除非恒定情形，再用法向双调和方程排除非零常值。四维环境的平坦法丛情形利用两个秩二丛及形算子共同主方向归约到单参数系统。
analysis.limitations: 第二定理依赖切丛与法丛均为秩二，且仅需法丛平坦；较高维或余维的任意双调和浸入仍超出结论。补读所列证明环节，未独立验证整篇证明。
